name: a-and-b-chemist
description: A&B Chemist pharmacy management platform — single-tenant build for one community pharmacy in Ghana

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=backend
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=shared && npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
scripts.test:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace=backend
scripts.test:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace=frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=shared && npm run lint --workspace=backend && npm run lint --workspace=frontend

author: Arthium Labs LLC
